briefing: Markets sold off sharply today, with the NASDAQ down 2.4% and the S&P 500 down 1.2%, so the screener returned no new candidates. We are holding all seven current positions and letting the automatic stop-loss and profit-target rules handle exits. The $545.88 in cash stays uninvested until conditions improve.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: A risk-off day is when investors get nervous and sell riskier investments like fast-growing tech stocks, moving money to safer places instead. The NASDAQ falling much more than the S&P 500 is a typical sign of this. On days like this, a sensible strategy is to avoid opening new positions and let existing protective rules, like stop-losses, do their job.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「避險模式」（Risk-Off）是指投資者情緒轉趨謹慎，拋售科技成長股等高風險資產，並將資金轉移至較安全的投資工具。納指跌幅明顯大於標普500，正是典型的避險訊號。遇上此類交易日，較穩健的做法是暫停建立新倉，讓止蝕等既有風控機制發揮作用。

market_education.summary_en: Stocks fell broadly today. The tech-heavy NASDAQ (-2.4%) dropped about twice as much as the S&P 500 (-1.2%), which usually means investors were selling higher-risk growth stocks and moving toward safer assets. No news headlines came with today's data, so we can't name a specific cause, and we have not made one up.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日美股全面走弱，以科技股為主的納斯達克指數下挫2.4%，跌幅約為標普500指數（-1.2%）的兩倍，反映資金撤出高估值成長股、轉向避險。由於今日數據未附相關新聞標題，暫無法確認具體觸發因素，本文亦不作臆測。
